db/statement#

Statements: SQL text with bound values, and what running one did.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let done = await db.execution(Statement(text: "DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires < ?", values: [DbInteger(now)]));
done.affected() else 0;

Description#

Statements: SQL text with bound values, and what running one did.

Statements are bounded by DbLimits: 1024 values, 8 MiB of values and 1 MiB of SQL by default. Most code passes SQL and values to execution() and query() directly.
